source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U18: Apply forum powers without assuming a universal monetary ceiling

payload.title: Evidence powers do not erase the forum type
payload.core_explanation_md:
The framework gives the described Lok Adalat civil-court-like powers for attendance, documents, affidavits and relevant public records. Those tools support the statutory purpose; they do not convert ordinary conciliators into a general court deciding every failed negotiation. The composition and organising authority also need their proper legal basis.

The courseware monetary-ceiling statement is not treated as a universal limit for every form of Lok Adalat. Ordinary and Permanent Lok Adalats differ, and any bank settlement delegation, statutory jurisdiction cap or later notification requires the correct source and date. A convenient round amount is not a substitute for that classification.

self_check.prompt_text: Can one textbook amount be applied indiscriminately to ordinary and Permanent Lok Adalat?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Identify the forum and the applicable legal or administrative limit.

payload.stem_md: A checklist applies one unsourced rupee ceiling to every ordinary and Permanent Lok Adalat matter. What is required?

options.text_md: Identify the forum type and evidence the actual applicable limit
options.explanation_md: Different regimes and administrative delegations must not be collapsed.

options.text_md: Select the largest number seen online
options.explanation_md: A number without legal context is not authority.

options.text_md: Use the claimants account balance as the jurisdiction rule
options.explanation_md: Balance is not itself the statutory cap.

options.text_md: Let either party invent its preferred monetary jurisdiction
options.explanation_md: Parties cannot privately define the legal forum.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Different regimes and administrative delegations must not be collapsed.

payload.stem_md: An ordinary conciliator uses the power to require documents as proof it may impose any settlement it wishes. Which distinction corrects that reasoning?

options.text_md: Document production always guarantees an imposed award
options.explanation_md: An evidentiary power does not define an unrestricted merits jurisdiction.

options.text_md: No conciliatory forum can ever examine a document
options.explanation_md: The framework expressly supplies evidence-related powers.

options.text_md: Evidence-gathering powers and the ordinary settlement role are distinct
options.explanation_md: Use the tools within the proper statutory function.

options.text_md: A power to summon automatically transfers creditor rights
options.explanation_md: Summoning does not transfer the debt.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Use the tools within the proper statutory function.
